node: Restaurant equipment, beverage-machine service, maintenance, and field support
summary: Expanded the public-company universe for the restaurant equipment/service/beverage-machine node. The cleanest direct public leader is Middleby, while Watsco is a less obvious second-order refrigeration/HVAC distribution exposure. Westrock Coffee is a small-cap beverage-supply-chain platform with foodservice and restaurant exposure but needs verification for installed-equipment/service economics. Performance Food Group is included as a broadline restaurant distribution/customer-access platform that touches kitchen equipment and supplies, but the maintenance/service chokepoint linkage is weaker. Farmer Brothers would have been a strong small-cap evidence candidate for coffee-equipment service and DSD, but it appears to have closed a take-private transaction on May 5, 2026, so it is excluded from the current US-listed candidate list.
